---
title: "Khuda Nigeh Dar Ke Mai Musafir -e- Shab Zinda Dar"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
tags: ["noUrdu"]

Shabe Zarbate mahe Ramzan,

Ali (as) Ka Yeh Kehna Hai,

Ye Zindagi Baad -e- Zehra

Ba Khuda Shakista Hai,

Aah Tere Baad Ay Zehra,

Mai Dil Soz – o- Shakista

Mai Dil Zaar -o- Girafta

Khuda Nigeh Dar Ke Mai Musafir -e- Shab Zinda Dar

Khuda Nigeh Dar Ki Mai Pay Kare Dil Figaar

Yaa Ali …..

Roz -o- Shab -e- Veerani

Zindagi Ye Zindani

Roz -o- Shabe Veerani

Zindagi Ye Zindani

Zindagi Ye Baad -e- Zehra (s.a.)

Ba Khuda Nahi Kat ti,

Khuda Nigeh Dar Ke Mai Musafir -e- Shab Zinda Dar

Khuda Nighe Dar Ki Mai Pay Kare Dil Figaar

Khuda Nigeh Dar Ke Mai Musafir -e- Shab Zindea Dar…..

Khuda Nigeh Dar Ki Mai Pay Kare Dil Figaar….. Yaa Ali…..(4)

Haaye Dard -e- Dil Mere

Jo Ali Na Keh Paaya

Raaz Woh Liye Dil Mein

Ja Raha Hai Ay Dunia

Kal Na Salooni sunuga

Kal Na Salooni Kahunga

Mein Chala Sue Kirdigar

Khuda Nigeh Dar Ke Mai Musafir -e- Shab Zindea Dar…..

Khuda Nigeh Dar Ki Mai Pay Kare Dil Figaar….. Yaa Ali…..(4)

Wo Ali (as) Hun Jungoo Mein

Jisne Maut Ko Ghera

Fatima (sa) Ki Furkat Mein Zabt Khogaya Mera

Haaye Tere Baad Ay Zahara

Haaye Veeran Hai Dunia

Mai Chala Suwe Kirdigar

Khuda Nigeh Dar Ke Mai Musafir -e- Shab Zindea Dar…..

Khuda Nigeh Dar Ki Mai Pay Kare Dil Figaar….. Yaa Ali…..(4)

Haaye Fatima (s.a.) Zehra,

Sabr Kaisa Paaya Tha

Raz Zakhmi Pehlu Ka,

Mujhse Bhi Chupaya Tha,

Mai Kabhi Bhool Na Paaye woh

Ter Pehlu Shakista

Mai Chala Suwe Kirdigar

Khuda Nigeh Dar Ke Mai Musafir -e- Shab Zindea Dar…..

Khuda Nigeh Dar Ki Mai Pay Kare Dil Figaar….. Yaa Ali…..(4)

Is Sitam Ne Ay Zahra

Kitna Mujhko Rulwaya

Mai Ali Tha Aur Tera

Haq Na Mai Dila Paya

Haaye Tu Dukhtar -ee Aaqa

Aur Darbar Mein Jaana

Mai Chala Suwe Kirdigar

Khuda Nigeh Dar Ke Mai Musafir -e- Shab Zindea Dar…..

Khuda Nigeh Dar Ki Mai Pay Kare Dil Figaar….. Yaa Ali…..(4)

Aa Raha Hoon Ay Zahra (sa)

Mai Bhi Janib -e- Manzil

Khuda Haafiz -o- Naasir

Mai Chala Suwe Qatil

Kal Mera Aakhri Kalma

Fuz To Be Rabbil kaba

Mai Chala Suwe Kirdigar

Khuda Nigeh Dar Ke Mai Musafir -e- Shab Zindea Dar…..

Khuda Nigeh Dar Ki Mai Pay Kare Dil Figaar….. Yaa Ali…..(4)

Mai Chala Suwe Qatil, Mai Chala Suwe Haasil,

Mai Chala Suwe Manzil, —-(2)

Mai Chala.

Reconstructed 67 Urdu-script verse lines and aligned them with the Roman transcription in `romanLyrics`. The edition includes six numbered stanzas, an opening, and a closing passage. Updated the title and reading direction, removed `noUrdu`, and verified that the diff has no whitespace errors.

I read “Pay Kare” as `پیکرِ` and “Ter Pehlu” as `ترا پہلو`. I treated `(4)` and `(2)` as recitation cues and preserved the refrain lines already written out.
